At 5, co-sleeping is really common and the switch usually works best with a gradual "camping out" approach - start by sitting beside his bed until he falls asleep, then move a little further toward the door each night. A consistent wind-down routine (bath, book, lights out at the same time every night) gives him the cue that sleep is coming without you right there.
